items.title: Russian sources allege push to mobilize Ukrainian students aged 25 and over
items.summary: Unnamed Russian security sources allege that Ukraine's military command is seeking to mobilize students aged 25 and over who currently have legal deferments. The claim has not been independently verified.

items.title: Western financial assistance to Ukraine reportedly reaches $69.9 billion in 2026
items.summary: A Russian media calculation based on Ukrainian Finance Ministry data puts Western financial assistance to Kyiv since the beginning of 2026 at approximately $69.9 billion, excluding deliveries of weapons and military equipment.
